text: - **A per-atom last-cause index** (`token_event_id → last WalletFact that touched it`) → answers *"why is **this specific** proof/token here?"* This is O(current state), not O(traffic), so a nutzap flood can't evict the cause of a token you still hold. Fable's addition — and it's the half of your question the ring alone can't answer. [...] 2. **The ring is never a rebuild authority** — restart rebuilds from Nostr + saga reconcile, entering as a `StateRebuilt` genesis fact. (Name it explicitly so nobody later "optimizes" restart into ring-replay.)
